  name1.name,
  COUNT(*)
FROM ((((((movie_info AS movie_info1 CROSS JOIN title AS title1) CROSS JOIN info_type AS info_type1) CROSS JOIN (name AS name1 CROSS JOIN cast_info AS cast_info1)) CROSS JOIN person_info AS person_info1) CROSS JOIN role_type AS role_type1) CROSS JOIN kind_type AS kind_type1) CROSS JOIN info_type AS info_type2
WHERE
  title1.id = cast_info1.movie_id
  AND title1.id = movie_info1.movie_id
  AND movie_info1.info_type_id = info_type1.id
  AND title1.kind_id = kind
